acceptance: A checked-out superseded branch is reported kept-checked-out and the run continues (red today)
A continuation-bound branch is never pruned
fix: Skip (and report as kept-checked-out) any ref checked out in a worktree (`git worktree list --porcelain`), and any ref a continuation binding names (kept-bound); a delete failure on one ref is reported per ref, never an abort of the rest.
summary: PruneSupersededOrphans runs `git branch -D` for every superseded cycle-* ref; a ref checked out in a worktree (a live lane, a kept failed cycle) makes git exit non-zero and the function returns an error, leaving every later ref unprocessed. It also does not consult the continuation registry, so a superseded branch a binding names would be deleted. Found in the 2026-09-29 cleanup: 50 superseded refs, including the live lane 1762 and kept 1757.
title: evolve branches prune --dry-run=false aborts the whole run on a superseded branch still checked out in a worktree, and ignores continuation bindings
